# superset_database_table (Data Source)

Describes a table or a view as Superset reads it from the database: its columns and their types, for example to declare the `columns` of a `superset_dataset`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "superset_database_table" "sales" {
  database_name = "Warehouse"
  schema        = "public"
  table_name    = "sales"
}

# The dataset declares every column of the table, with the detected types kept.
resource "superset_dataset" "sales" {
  table_name    = "sales"
  database_name = "Warehouse"
  schema        = "public"
  columns       = [for column in data.superset_database_table.sales.columns : { column_name = column.name }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection.
- `schema` (String) Name of the schema.
- `table_name` (String) Name of the table or view.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) Columns of the table, in the order of the database. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `comment` (String) Comment of the table in the database.
- `database_id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the connection.

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Comment of the column in the database.
- `long_type` (String) Full type of the column, for example `NUMERIC(10, 2)`.
- `name` (String) Name of the column.
- `type` (String) Generic type of the column, for example `NUMERIC`.
